description: Lend a neighbour a hand with a chore that's due at their house (mow, bins, dishes …), or with their building (build): it takes a few real minutes there and pays a little. With no chore named, says what they could use a hand with.

chore.description: Optional: the chore (mow, bins, dishes, plants, drapes, porch, mail) or build.

name: help_neighbour
title: Lend a neighbour a hand
